title: Effect of Sintering Temperature on the Microstructure and Integrated Properties of MgAlTiVFeCo Lightweight High-Entropy Alloy

recollection.structure: guess: refined microstructure with varying grain sizes
recollection.mechanism: guess: diffusion and precipitation of alloying elements
recollection.results: guess: improved mechanical properties and reduced density with optimal sintering temperature

score.note: The recollection only identifies varying sintering temperatures, as stated in the title, and misses SPS at the optimal 1000 °C. The proposed grain refinement does not match the dense microstructure with uniformly distributed oxide barrier phases. Diffusion and precipitation are vaguely relevant but omit the passive-film, chloride-blocking, and diffusion-controlled oxidation mechanisms. No quantitative results are recalled.
